metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code (COBOL) with a batch entry point (PAYRUN program) and JCL job control present. No library publish configuration or multi-service structure. Classified as application.
metadata.archetype_justification: The system reads from a persistent data store (DB2/indexed files), performs business logic (payroll calculation), and writes output records. It has no API surface, no message queues, and no multi-service orchestration. The ambiguous batch nature defaults to stateful-crud as the conservative choice.

classification_consistency_check.reason: Score 1.15 yields Not Ready band but 11 High findings (below the ≥12 threshold) force Remediation Required tier. The system has no deployed workload (has_deployed_workload=false), causing 5 surface-gated questions (INF-Q9, OPS-Q5, OPS-Q7, OPS-Q9, SEC-Q1) to be excluded from evaluation, reducing the potential High count below 12.

findings.title: Managed Compute
findings.description: All compute runs on an IBM z/OS mainframe (COBOL batch) and a raw EC2 m4.large file gateway. No managed container orchestration or serverless services in use.
findings.gap: No managed compute services in use. System depends on legacy mainframe compute and a single unmanaged EC2 instance.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite payroll logic and deploy on AWS managed compute (ECS/Fargate or AWS Batch). Replace EC2 file gateway with AWS Transfer Family.

findings.title: Managed Databases
findings.description: Database is IBM DB2 for z/OS v10, self-managed on mainframe. No AWS managed database services in use.
findings.gap: All databases self-managed on mainframe. DB2 v10 past EOL since April 2020.
findings.recommendation: Migrate from DB2 on z/OS to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL using AWS SCT and DMS.

findings.title: Workflow Orchestration
findings.description: Workflow orchestration entirely hardcoded in JCL. Two-step sequential workflow with no dedicated orchestration service.
findings.gap: No orchestration — all workflow logic hardcoded in JCL with no error handling or retry logic.
findings.recommendation: Implement AWS Step Functions to orchestrate the modernized payroll workflow.

findings.title: Async Messaging and Streaming
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure. Only data movement is plaintext FTP file transfer.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes cross service boundaries. FTP is a primitive integration pattern with no delivery guarantees.
findings.recommendation: Replace FTP with managed messaging (EventBridge for payroll events, SQS for reliable delivery).

findings.title: Network Security
findings.description: No VPC, subnet, security group, or network segmentation. Plaintext FTP to hard-coded IP with PII traversing unencrypted.
findings.gap: No network security controls. Sensitive PII (SSN, bank accounts) traverses the network unencrypted.
findings.recommendation: Replace plaintext FTP with SFTP (AWS Transfer Family). Deploy modernized services in VPC with private subnets and VPC endpoints.

findings.title: API Entry Point
findings.description: No API Gateway, ALB, or managed entry point. Only external-facing component is EC2 with plaintext FTP.
findings.gap: Services exposed directly with no gateway or load balancer.
findings.recommendation: Implement API Gateway with authentication, throttling, and request validation for the modernized payroll API.

findings.title: Auto-Scaling
findings.description: No auto-scaling. Mainframe has static capacity (REGION=0M). EC2 gateway is single statically-provisioned instance.
findings.gap: All capacity statically provisioned. Batch window overruns indicate insufficient capacity.
findings.recommendation: Use AWS Batch with auto-scaling compute environments for the modernized payroll processing.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery
findings.description: No backup configuration in the repository. Mainframe datasets have no visible backup strategy.
findings.gap: No backup configuration found. Data loss recovery depends on unknown external procedures.
findings.recommendation: Enable automated backups with defined retention when migrating to managed databases. Configure PITR and cross-region replication.

findings.title: Infrastructure as Code Coverage
findings.description: Zero IaC coverage. No Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, or any IaC. All infrastructure manually provisioned.
findings.gap: No IaC — all infrastructure created manually. Non-reproducible, error-prone, undocumented.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure in IaC from day one using CloudFormation or CDK. Target 100% coverage.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation
findings.description: No CI/CD automation. No pipeline definitions. All deployments manual.
findings.gap: No CI/CD — all deployments are manual scripts or mainframe operations.
findings.recommendation: Establish CI/CD pipelines with AWS CodePipeline/CodeBuild from the start of modernization.

findings.title: Programming Languages
findings.description: COBOL (Enterprise COBOL 4.2) with JCL. No AWS SDK, no cloud-native tooling, scarce developer skills.
findings.gap: Language with no AWS SDK and no cloud-native tooling. Requires custom integration or rewrite.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite in a modern language (Python 3.12+ or Java 21+ with Spring Boot 3.x) with first-class AWS SDK support.

findings.title: Monolith vs Microservices
findings.description: Single tightly-coupled COBOL program with no module boundaries. All functionality in one program.
findings.gap: Tightly-coupled monolith with no module boundaries, pervasive shared state.
findings.recommendation: Decompose into independent services during rewrite. See Decomposition Strategy section.

findings.title: Async vs Sync Communication
findings.description: All communication synchronous/sequential. Batch processes records sequentially and outputs via synchronous FTP.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous with no async patterns. FTP output has no delivery guarantees.
findings.recommendation: Implement async communication for payroll events using EventBridge and SQS.

findings.title: Long-Running Process Handling
findings.description: Payroll batch runs 5-7 hours as single synchronous operation with no checkpointing or status polling.
findings.gap: All operations synchronous regardless of duration. No checkpointing means failure requires full reprocessing.
findings.recommendation: Implement async job processing with Step Functions, chunked processing, status tracking, and checkpointing.

findings.title: API Versioning Strategy
findings.description: No API versioning. Only external interface is fixed-width 120-byte flat file with no schema/versioning.
findings.gap: No versioning — format changes break all consumers simultaneously.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning from day one when modernizing (e.g., /v1/payroll/).

findings.title: Service Discovery
findings.description: All endpoints hard-coded. IP address 10.0.7.40 and dataset names hard-coded in JCL.
findings.gap: All service endpoints hard-coded. Relocating any component requires JCL modification.
findings.recommendation: Use environment variables or AWS Cloud Map for all service endpoints. Never hard-code IPs.

findings.title: Unstructured Data Storage
findings.description: All data on mainframe datasets (VSAM indexed files) and fixed-width flat files transferred via FTP to EC2 local filesystem.
findings.gap: Data on local file systems and legacy mainframe storage. Inaccessible for modern workloads.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Amazon S3 with structured formats (Parquet, JSON). Use S3 lifecycle policies for archival.

findings.title: Unified Data Access Layer
findings.description: No data access layer. COBOL program directly performs file I/O with data format parsing embedded in business logic.
findings.gap: No abstraction. File I/O, data format definitions, and business logic are co-located.
findings.recommendation: Implement repository/DAO pattern with dedicated data access layer and ORM when modernizing.

findings.title: Database Engine Version and EOL
findings.description: IBM DB2 for z/OS v10 past end-of-life since April 2020. No version pinning in IaC (no IaC exists).
findings.gap: Engine past EOL. No security patches, no vendor support. Compliance and security risk.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to supported managed database (Aurora PostgreSQL). Use AWS SCT and DMS.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. PII (SSN, bank accounts) stored in plaintext mainframe datasets and flat files.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest. Highly sensitive PII stored and transmitted in cleartext.
findings.recommendation: Encrypt all data at rest with customer-managed KMS keys. Implement field-level encryption for PII.

findings.title: API Authentication
findings.description: No API authentication. Only mechanism is hardcoded FTP username/password in JCL.
findings.gap: No API authentication. Static credentials hardcoded in source — not token-based, not rotatable.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2/JWT authentication via Amazon Cognito on all API endpoints.

findings.title: Centralized Identity Integration
findings.description: No centralized identity provider. System uses hardcoded username/password with no external IdP.
findings.gap: Application manages authentication entirely with no external IdP integration.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Amazon Cognito. Implement SSO for admin access. Use IAM roles for service-to-service auth.

findings.title: Secrets Management
findings.description: Plaintext credentials hardcoded in JCL: FTP username 'payroll' and password 'PayR0ll2003!' in source control.
findings.gap: Plaintext credentials in source control. Deployment-blocking security vulnerability.
findings.recommendation: Immediately rotate exposed credentials. Store all secrets in AWS Secrets Manager with automated rotation.

findings.title: Compute Hardening and Patching
findings.description: No patching strategy or vulnerability scanning. DB2 v10 past EOL is unpatchable. EC2 gateway has no visible patching.
findings.gap: No patching strategy; no vulnerability scanning.
findings.recommendation: Use managed compute (Fargate, Lambda) for automatic patching. If EC2 needed, implement SSM Patch Manager and Inspector.

findings.title: Application Security Pipeline
findings.description: No security scanning tools configured. No SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, or container scanning. No CI/CD pipeline exists.
findings.gap: No security scanning tools — no pipeline exists to integrate them into.
findings.recommendation: Integrate SAST (CodeGuru/Semgrep), dependency scanning (Dependabot/Snyk), and container scanning from day one.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing
findings.description: No distributed tracing. COBOL program has no instrumentation capabilities.
findings.gap: No tracing. Cannot trace execution path or correlate errors to specific inputs.
findings.recommendation: Instrument all modernized services with AWS X-Ray or OpenTelemetry from day one.

findings.title: SLO Definitions
findings.description: No SLOs defined. Batch overruns acknowledged but no formal SLO or monitoring.
findings.gap: No SLOs — no formal definition of acceptable service levels.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for payroll processing: completion time, accuracy, delivery reliability.

findings.title: Business Metrics
findings.description: No custom metrics. Batch produces no telemetry about employees processed or payroll amounts.
findings.gap: No custom metrics. No visibility into business outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Publish business metrics: employees processed, total payroll, errors per run, processing time per employee.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting
findings.description: No alerting. Failures detected only when batch overruns or downstream systems report missing data.
findings.gap: No alerting configured. Failures go undetected until downstream impact.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms on batch duration, error rates, record count deviations, payment anomalies.

findings.title: Integration Testing
findings.description: No automated tests of any kind. README states: 'No automated tests; changes validated in a shared QA region only.'
findings.gap: No integration tests — no automated tests at all. High regression risk.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated tests from day one: unit, integration, and end-to-end tests in CI pipeline.

findings.title: Observability Ownership
findings.description: No observability ownership. No dashboards, alarms, CODEOWNERS, or SLO definitions with team attribution.
findings.gap: No observability ownership — monitoring is reactive and fragmented.
findings.recommendation: Establish per-service dashboards, assign alarm ownership, define SLOs with team attribution.
